'''Spidertaur''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used for protection on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. They had [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons with which to fight.<ref name="SSW">''[[Super Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
These armed droids are enemies in the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] game ''[[Super Star Wars]]'', where players first encounter them on "Level 10: Death Star Bay." ''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]'' first mentions the name of the droid as being a "Spidertaur".<ref name="Game Secrets">''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]''</ref>
